description: This file implements ONNX function extraction logic for PyTorch JIT, including scope partitioning, function graph construction, and attribute handling.

classes.name: FunctionExtractor
classes.description: Main class for extracting functions from a graph based on scope analysis.

classes.name: FunctionExtractor::ScopeContext
classes.description: Represents a scope context with nodes, inputs, outputs, and children scopes.

classes.name: FunctionExtractor::FunctionContext
classes.description: Holds context for a specific function, including scope, attributes, and node mappings.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::run
methods.description: Performs scope partitioning, scope comparison, and function extraction, returning a mapping of attribute names.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::ConstructFuncGraph
methods.description: Constructs a subgraph for a given function context.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::CreateFunctionDefNode
methods.description: Creates a local function definition node in the graph.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::CreateFunctionNode
methods.description: Creates a function call node in the graph for a scope.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::ConvertScopeToFunction
methods.description: Converts a scope and its nodes into a function, replacing nodes with function calls.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::ScopeContext::PopulateInputsOutputs
methods.description: Determines the input and output values for a scope based on its nodes.

methods.name: FunctionExtractor::ScopeContext::IsIdenticalFunction
methods.description: Checks if two scope contexts represent identical functions.
